## Deputies Elections

There have been 8 elections (8 contested) for Deputy held in St Helier No 2 since 2002.

* * *

### 2002 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (3 seats), 27th November 2002.

**[Jennifer Bridge](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jennifer-bridge), [Terry Le Main](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/terry-le-main) and [Geoff Southern](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geoff-southern) were elected as Deputies of St Helier No 2 in 2002.**

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Jennifer Bridge](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jennifer-bridge)** |  | 785 | 68.7% |
| 2 | **[Terry Le Main](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/terry-le-main)** |  | 658 | 57.6% |
| 3 | **[Geoff Southern](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geoff-southern)** |  | 609 | 53.3% |
| 4 | [Ian McFirbishigh](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ian-mcfirbishigh) |  | 577 | 50.5% |

1,143 ballots (inc. 5 spoilt papers)

3,526 registered voters

32.4% turnout

### 2014 St Helier No 2 Deputy By-Election

Following the loss of a libel action regarding a satirical cartoon, Trevor Pitman and Shona Pitman were disqualified from the States in January 2014 after being declared bankrupt (1 seat), 5th March 2014.

**[Sam Mézec](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sam-mezec) was elected as Deputy of St Helier No 2 in 2014**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Sam Mézec](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sam-mezec)** | Reform Jersey | 277 | 52.5% |
| 2 | [Ian Philpot](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ian-philpot) |  | 99 | 18.8% |
| 3 | [Bernard Manning](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/bernard-manning) |  | 87 | 16.5% |
| 4 | [Paul Huelin](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/paul-huelin) |  | 65 | 12.3% |

528 votes

3,771 registered voters

14% turnout

_Registered voters estimated._
